latest_release.name: Pulse Update (v3.5.0)
latest_release.body:
You can now explore the world with endless generation! With Live One World mode, Arnis starts a Minecraft server for you and keeps generating the land ahead of you as you explore. You can open it to LAN too, so friends can jump in. Cities feel a lot more alive this time. Cars, trains and boats got all-new models, people walk the sidewalks and planes take off and land at airports. Where open laser scans (LiDAR) are available, Arnis can use them for more accurate building generation and gardens. Buildings, roads, bridges, train stations and stadiums are also a lot closer to reality now. The biggest addition under the hood is Meld, a set of advanced features ported over by Teddy. It splits big One World maps into cells that build in parallel, which makes really large areas possible. It also brings Projects to manage your worlds and more generation customization options. You'll find all of it under Advanced features. On top of that you can draw any shape instead of a rectangle and Hytale worlds can now be generated. ## Assets * Windows: arnis-windows.exe * Linux: arnis-linux * MacOS: arnis-mac-universal **Scroll down to find the download in _Assets._**
Click to expand ## What's Changed * Region writer follow-ups: one slot decision for the writer and the voxy LOD by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1459 * Railway stations: platforms by the tracks, halls under ground, stairs from the entrances by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1465 * Race tracks: circuit widths, kerbs through the corners, edge lines and start lines by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1469 * Sports venues: real-scale stadiums per sport, field markings, golf courses by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1470 * Vehicles and community fixes: steady traffic, lanes, riding cars and trains, decayed ruins by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1479 * Fixes after 3.4: summits, building parts, brick roofs, Overture water, lighthouses, observation wheels by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1482 * Live mode: play the One World while Arnis generates the land around you by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1484 * Build Live's link check only where it is used by @Teddy563 in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1488 * One World: a building across an area edge gets the same floor on both sides by @Teddy563 in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1489 * Ships, ferries and pedestrians for the moving vehicles extras by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1487 * Java: the same world on every run (palette entries no longer depend on hash map order) by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1493 * Bedrock save: bulk-load the LevelDB on all cores by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1490 * Bedrock: build the area on the parallel tile path, as Java does by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1492 * Area shapes (polygons, several areas in one world), Discord status, unused deps removed by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1491 * PR benchmark: post results on fork PRs too by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1509 * The full set of Confluence 3.5.0 changes in one pull request (good luck)✨ by @Teddy563 in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1508 * Add JSON progress lines and machine knobs for programs that drive the CLI by @Teddy563 in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1499 * Build large One World areas as parallel region-aligned cells by @Teddy563 in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1500 * Read OSM data from extracts and fetch an area first for offline builds by @Teddy563 in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1501 * Add the Linear region format, origin, world border, map item and LOD-only outpu

# Arnis [![CI Build Status](https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/actions/workflows/ci-build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/actions) [](https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/releases) [](https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/releases) [![Download here](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-here-green)](https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/releases) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1326192999738249267?label=Discord&color=%237289da)](https://discord.gg/mA2g69Fhxq) Arnis creates complex and accurate Minecraft Java Edition (1.21.4+), Bedrock Edition, Luanti (Minetest) and Hytale worlds that reflect real-world geography, topography, and architecture. This free and open source project is designed to handle large-scale geographic data from the real world and generate detailed Minecraft worlds. The algorithm processes geospatial data from OpenStreetMap as well as elevation data to create an accurate Minecraft representation of terrain and architecture. Generate your hometown, big cities, and natural landscapes with ease! _**Want mobile generation or larger map sizes?** [MapSmith](https://arnismc.com/mapsmith/) generates worlds in your browser, no install required._ ![Minecraft Preview](assets/git/preview.jpg) This GitHub page and [arnismc.com](https://arnismc.com) are the only official project websites. Do not download Arnis from any other website. ## :keyboard: Usage
Download the [latest release](https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/releases/) or [compile](#trophy-open-source) the project on your own. Choose your area on the map using the rectangle tool, then simply click on Start Generation! Additionally, you can customize various generation settings, such as world scale, spawn point, or building interior generation. ## 📚 Documentation Full documentation is available in the [GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/wiki/), covering topics such as generation settings, command line usage, technical explanations, FAQs and contribution guidelines. [backgroundvid.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/420acc19-a850-418e-8397-1a45b05582ab) ## :trophy: Open Source #### Key objectives of this project - **Modularity**: Ensure that all components (e.g., data fetching, processing, and world generation) are cleanly separated into distinct modules for better maintainability and scalability. - **Performance Optimization**: We aim to maintain strong performance and fast world generation. - **Comprehensive Documentation**: Detailed in-code documentation for a clear structure and logic. - **User-Friendly Experience**: Focus on making the project easy to use for end users. - **Cross-Platform Support**: We want this project to run smoothly on Windows, macOS, and Linux. #### How to contribute This project is open source and welcomes contributions from everyone! Whether you're interested in fixing bugs, improving performance, adding new features, or enhancing documentation, your input is valuable. Simply fork the repository, make your changes, and submit a pull request. Please respect the above-mentioned key objectives. Contributions of all levels are appreciated, and your efforts help improve this tool for everyone. Command line Build: ```cargo run --release --no-default-features -- --output-dir="C:/YOUR_PATH/.minecraft/saves" --bbox="min_lat,min_lng,max_lat,max_lng"```
GUI Build: ```cargo run --release```
All command line options, like the generation modes, winter and One World, are explained on the [Command Line Usage](https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/wiki/Command-Line-Usage) wiki page. After your pull request is merged, I will take care of regularly creating update releases which will include your changes. If you are using Nix, you can run the program directly with `nix run github:louis-e/arnis -- --output-dir=YOUR_PATH/.minecraft/saves --bbox="min_lat,min_lng,max_lat,max_lng"` ## :star: Star History ## :newspaper: Academic & Press Recognition Arnis has been recognized in various academic and press publications after gaining more attention in December 2024. [Building realistic Minecraft worlds with Open Data on AWS: How Arnis uses elevation datasets at scale](https://aws.amazon.com/de/blogs/publicsector/building-realistic-minecraft-worlds-with-open-data-on-aws-how-arnis-uses-elevation-datasets-at-scale/) [Floodcraft: Game-based Interactive Learning Environment using Minecraft for Flood Mitigation and Preparedness for K-12 Education](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/384644535_Floodcraft_Game-based_Interactive_Learning_Environment_using_Minecraft_for_Flood_Mitigation_and_Preparedness_for_K-12_Education) [Hackaday: Bringing OpenStreetMap Data into Minecraft](https://hackaday.com/2024/12/30/bringing-openstreetmap-data-into-minecraft/) [TomsHardware: Minecraft Tool Lets You Create Scale Replicas of Real-World Locations](https://www.tomshardware.com/video-games/pc-gaming/minecraft-tool-lets-you-create-scale-replicas-of-real-world-locations-arnis-uses-geospatial-data-from-openstreetmap-to-generate-minecraft-maps) [XDA Developers: Hometown Minecraft Map: Arnis](https://www.xda-developers.com/hometown-minecraft-map-arnis/) Free to use press assets, including screenshots and logos, can be found [here](https://arnismc.com/presskit/). ## :lock: Code Signing Policy Free code signing provided by [SignPath.io](https://about.signpath.io/), certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org/). The Windows executable is built from this repository by the [release workflow](.github/workflows/release.yml) on GitHub-hosted runners and is only signed after a maintainer approves the signing request. All roles (committer, reviewer and approver) are held by [louis-⁠e](https://github.com/louis-e).
